answer.reason: Several marked verses state events belonging to Asia: the Holy Ghost forbade preaching there, all its dwellers heard the word, and Paul's trouble there.

clauses.english: was where the Holy Ghost forbade Paul and his companions to preach the word
clauses.quote: forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia

clauses.english: was where all who dwelt there, Jews and Greeks, heard the word of the Lord Jesus during two years
clauses.quote: all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks

clauses.english: was where Paul met trouble beyond measure, so that he despaired even of life
clauses.quote: our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure

doubts: ACT 19:26-27 (Demetrius's complaint) and the seven churches of Revelation 1 were left out as speech or address rather than events.
ACT 2:9, ACT 6:9, ACT 20:4, ACT 21:27, ACT 24:18 mention Asians or travel there only; ROM 16:5 names Achaia in the Greek and may not concern Asia.
